title: DeployDefaults
description: Central, non-secret CD defaults owned by Platform / SRE. Per-app deploy/<env>.yml never redefines these.

deployRolePattern.description: GitHub-OIDC deploy role ARN in the app's account. {account} is substituted from the app's deploy/<env>.yml infra.account (not runnerAccount); {service}, {env} also substituted.

runnerAccount.description: Central account (owned by central DevOps) that hosts the CI runners for this environment. Same for every app. The app's own deploy-target account is deploy/<env>.yml infra.account.

region.description: Default AWS region; an app may override via deploy/<env>.yml infra.region.

requireApproval.description: Informational mirror of the GitHub Environment protection rule.

bakeMinutes.description: Post-deploy soak before the job reports success (blue-green / canary).
